after_change.counter_definition: Count every os.scandir entry yielded for the dedicated root; root-level scans only. No wall time recorded.
limitations: Entry visits remain O(N^2) across N sequential writes because each write retains an independent external-change precheck and post-write scan; root scans per write fell from five to three.
This is a local synthetic entry-count measurement only; source was not yet fixed/locked for acceptance, and results are not a whole-run SLO or Docker/product measurement.
scan_roles: lock-held initial strict flat-root scan initializes StorageBudget
atomic_write independent precheck detects intervening external changes
atomic_write post-accounting strict scan validates final root and bytes
semantics_preserved: symlink/reparse/type/hardlink checks where filesystem metadata exposes them
temp cleanup, fsync, replace and crash behavior
after_change.trust_boundary: Initial _FlatRootMeasurement is produced under the bounded writer OS operation lock for this write and immediately consumed by private StorageBudget._from_flat_measurement; never cached across writes or accepted as a public caller value.

contract_notes.proposed_minimal_change: Use one strict flat-root scanner that validates direct-entry ceiling, regular file type, symlink/reparse/hardlink rejection and sums file bytes. Reuse its initial byte sum to initialize StorageBudget (combines the first bounded-tree + constructor walk), retain atomic_write precheck to detect intervening external changes, and combine atomic_write post-accounting with bounded post-tree validation (one strict final scan). Retain StorageBudget lock/reservation, target digest readback, atomic replace/fsync, and before/after accounting semantics. Do not cache root counts across writes because external modification detection would weaken.

counter_definition.entry_visits: number of os.scandir entries yielded for the dedicated root, attributed to the active scanner function
counter_definition.storage_measure_calls: calls to storage_budget._measure_root via StorageBudget construction and atomic_write

not_measured_or_claimed: whether proposed combined scanner preserves every platform reparse-point contract; requires code review and tests

observed_pattern.growth: Entry visits grow quadratically in document count for this flat-root implementation: 5 scans per write (2 bounded-tree + 3 StorageBudget root measures), each scan visits the currently present root entries. The measured 100-to-200 ratio is 3.9608; no timing/SLO claim.
observed_pattern.scans_each_write: bounded_files: preflight and postwrite; StorageBudget: constructor, atomic_write precheck, atomic_write post-accounting

post_review_correction.change: The private strict flat-root scanner now calls os.stat(entry.path, follow_symlinks=False), classifies directory/regular/symlink/reparse from that result only, and rejects missing/invalid/non-positive link counts fail-closed. General StorageBudget scanner remains unchanged.
post_review_correction.corrected_windows_note: Prior claim that Windows hardlink detection was filesystem-limited was incorrect and is superseded. The platform DirEntry.stat metadata was the issue; fresh os.stat hardlink rejection passed on this Windows filesystem.
post_review_correction.hardlink_test: tests.test_bounded_files.BoundedFileTests.test_regular_file_hardlink_is_rejected_by_fresh_stat PASS using an actual filesystem hardlink.
post_review_correction.prior_measurement_scope: The immediately preceding 100/200 measurement belongs to the earlier source hashes in after_change.source_hashes_before_after_measurement. The current correction has these distinct hashes and was validated with the same counter test, but the counts are maintained by test assertion rather than a second separately timed profile.
post_review_correction.reason: Python Windows DirEntry.stat may report st_nlink=0; os.stat is the fresh metadata source required for reliable hardlink detection.

scan_counter_recheck.result: PASS; counter regression test rerun after correction

post_review_correction.stat_cost: The number of root scans and yielded-entry visits is unchanged; strict scanner now performs one fresh os.stat call per yielded root entry per strict scan (3*N document-level metadata calls), increasing metadata syscall work. No wall latency was measured.

scope.entrypoint_note: Checkpoint.put without injected StorageBudget delegates to write_bounded; this audit isolates that path directly.
scope.storage_budget_mode: recursive=False; per-file quota 256 MiB; immutable documents; dedicated TemporaryDirectory for each case
